concerns.location: plan.md:## Implementation Tasks (Mapping FR/SC → Outputs) → T008
concerns.text: Bootstrap confidence intervals for pairwise halide performance differences are computed from only 5 cross‑validation folds (GroupKFold). Resampling such a small set (10 000 bootstrap samples) can severely underestimate uncertainty and produce over‑confident CIs. Recommend augmenting the CV scheme (e.g., repeated GroupKFold or nested CV) to obtain a larger effective sample size before bootstrapping, or use a permutation test that respects the limited number of folds.
